title: Indian-Style Menemen
description: A fusion of Indian and Turkish flavors, this menemen recipe adds an umami twist to the classic Turkish dish.
instructions: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
2. Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add the menemen to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned.
4. Add the turkish spice blend to the skillet and stir to combine.
5. Add the umami (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Pour the whisked eggs over the menemen mixture in the skillet.
7. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are almost set.
8. Use a spatula to gently scramble the eggs, breaking them up into small curds.
9. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the eggs are fully cooked.
10. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
